title: Seattle Grocery Deals week file
description: One week of flyers and every readable sale item from them. File name is data/weeks/<week>.json, where week is that Friday's Pacific date. scripts/validate.mjs runs extra checks beyond this schema. Highlighting and ranking are computed by the build.

week.description: The Friday this week is named for (Pacific date).

flyers.description: One entry per store checked this week.

items.description: Every readable sale item from the flyers. Leave out anything whose price could not be read.

status.description: full: read in full. partial: some pages or sections not read (say which in note). stale: printed dates are not this week. unreadable: no prices could be read.

links.description: Exact link(s) to this week's flyer. One per page or image when the store has several.

item.description: Item name as printed on the flyer.

item_key.description: Normalized key from config/items.json, used to compare across stores and weeks. Null when no key fits.

price.description: Sale price as printed, for `quantity` units. For "4 for $5", price is 5 and quantity is 4.

unit.description: lb: price per pound. each: per item. pack: per package, with pack size given.

unit_price.description: Price per standard unit, rounded to cents. Null only when it cannot be computed.

regular_price.description: Only if the store printed it (or printed an exact savings amount). Same quantity and unit as price.

percent_off.description: Whole percent. Computed from regular_price, or as printed when only a percent is printed.

member_price.description: True for member, loyalty-card or app-only prices.

valid_through.description: Last day of the sale price. Null to use the flyer's valid_through.

notes.description: Limits, while supplies last, member details, location caveats, "save up to" text. Empty string if none.

highlight.description: Optional hand pick: marks the item as a standout and shows the one-line reason.
